description.text: The eleventh expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released on 15 July 2022, which brought back the Lost Zone as a theme. Cards with Lost Zone effects carry a special effect in their illustration and frame. Giratina VSTAR leads it: its VSTAR Power attack Star Requiem knocks out the opponent's Active Pokémon once its player has ten or more cards in the Lost Zone. Comfey, whose Ability adds a card to the hand and another to the Lost Zone, Colress's Experiment, Mirage Gate, Lost City, Cramorant, Banette and Rotom V work with it, joined by Drapion VSTAR, Kyurem VMAX, Aerodactyl VSTAR and Delphox V. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 100, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR, Kyurem VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Giratina VSTAR, Lost Vacuum and Collapsed Stadium. In English most of its cards came out in Lost Origin in September 2022 and Silver Tempest in November 2022.
